solutionStrategy: Use the noun after the blank, not the nearby location, to choose the number of the existential verb.
solutionSteps: Read the noun phrase after the blank.
Notice that two chairs is plural.
Match a plural noun with There are.
Reject There is and the ungrammatical pronoun forms.
Select B and check the full classroom statement.
